candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never convulse before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Pikin na 18 months old. Pikin get cough and e get wahala to breathe. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Pikin no get ear problem. Pikin no get fever. Dem count pikin breath for one minute. Dem do bronchodilator trial finish. Pikin no get chest wey dey go inside when e dey breathe. Pikin calm. Cough don dey for 3 days. Dem count pikin breath for one minute after bronchodilator. After bronchodilator, pikin no get chest wey dey go inside. After bronchodilator, pikin still calm. After bronchodilator, pikin dey breathe 42 times for one minute. Pulse oximeter no dey available. Pikin no get history of wheeze wey dey come back. Pikin dey breathe 45 times for one minute. Pikin no get stridor when e calm. Pikin dey wheeze now.
